paragraphs.hr: Ben je turist iz Engleske. Danas je prvi put u Zagrebu. Ulazi u kafić blizu Trga bana Jelačića. Kafić se zove Mali Medo. Unutra je toplo i mirno. Ben sjeda za mali stol kraj prozora.
paragraphs.en: Ben is a tourist from England. Today is his first time in Zagreb. He enters a café near Ban Jelačić Square. The café is called Mali Medo. Inside it is warm and quiet. Ben sits down at a small table by the window.

paragraphs.hr: Konobarica Ana dolazi do stola. Ona se osmijehuje i kaže: Dobar dan! Što želite? Ben kaže: Dobar dan! Jednu kavu, molim. Ana pita: Toplu ili hladnu? Ben odgovara: Toplu, molim vas. Ana odlazi i donosi kavu za dvije minute.
paragraphs.en: Waitress Ana comes to the table. She smiles and says: Good afternoon! What would you like? Ben says: Good afternoon! One coffee, please. Ana asks: Hot or cold? Ben replies: Hot, please. Ana goes away and brings the coffee in two minutes.

paragraphs.hr: Ben pita: Koliko košta kava? Ana odgovara: Jedan euro i pedeset centi. Ben plaća karticom. On kaže hvala na hrvatskom. Ana se veseli — turist govori hrvatski! Ona kaže: Govorite li vi hrvatski? Ben odgovara: Malo. Učim šest mjeseci.
paragraphs.en: Ben asks: How much does the coffee cost? Ana replies: One euro and fifty cents. Ben pays by card. He says thank you in Croatian. Ana is pleased — the tourist speaks Croatian! She says: Do you speak Croatian? Ben replies: A little. I have been learning for six months.

paragraphs.hr: Ana sjeda na stolicu kraj Bena. Ona pita: Jeste li prvi put u Zagrebu? Ben odgovara: Da, to je moj prvi posjet. Zagreb je lijep grad. Ana se smiješi i kaže: Hvala! Zagreb je moj grad. Ima puno starih zgrada, parkova i dobrih restorana.
paragraphs.en: Ana sits down on a chair next to Ben. She asks: Is this your first time in Zagreb? Ben replies: Yes, this is my first visit. Zagreb is a beautiful city. Ana smiles and says: Thank you! Zagreb is my city. There are many old buildings, parks and good restaurants.

paragraphs.hr: Ben pije kavu polako. Kava je ukusna i vruća. On gleda ljude koji prolaze ulicom kroz prozor. Zagreb je lijep — puno starih zgrada i zelenih parkova. Ben je sretan. On želi opet doći u ovaj kafić sutra. On kaže doviđenja i odlazi u grad.
paragraphs.en: Ben drinks his coffee slowly. The coffee is delicious and hot. He watches the people walking along the street through the window. Zagreb is beautiful — many old buildings and green parks. Ben is happy. He wants to come back to this café again tomorrow. He says goodbye and sets off into the city.
